svg.title: Coax, microstrip and stripline cross-sections with field lines
svg.desc: Three cross-sections. Coax: radial electric field lines from the centre wire to the outer conductor and circular magnetic field lines, all inside the dielectric. Microstrip: field lines from a trace down to a ground plane, mostly in the board, some fringing through the air. Stripline: a trace buried between two ground planes, with all field lines inside the dielectric.
svg.text: Three common transmission lines, seen end-on, with their fields
Microstrip and stripline field lines come from a 2-D solve of each cross-section (FR-4, εr = 4.4). Not drawn to the same scale.
